description: Publishes the draft as a new immutable version in pending_review. Refused with 422 test_inputs_not_passing and the per-input failure reasons unless the last test ran on this exact manifest and every test_inputs entry passed. Paid listings also need verified Stripe Connect (409 connect_not_ready). Needs an API key with the listings:write scope.
name: alterlab_listing_publish
title: Publish Listing Draft
